strings.accounts.RemoveIfNothingPointsAt: Remove, if nothing points at it

strings.payeeform.Name: NAME
strings.payeeform.AStatementSSpellingLands: A statement's spelling lands on this payee once it is an alias.
strings.payeeform.MovesEveryTransactionAndKeeps: Moves every transaction and keeps this name as an alias
strings.payeeform.OnlyAPayeeNoTransaction: Only a payee no transaction names can go
strings.acctform.Name: NAME
strings.dash.NoCloudNoTrackingJust: No cloud. No tracking. Just you.
strings.dash.NoBudgetsYetPress4: No budgets yet. Press 4 to plan one.
strings.dash.NothingYetPressNTo: Nothing yet. Press n to add one in under ten seconds.
strings.dash.NothingDueInTheNext: Nothing due in the next thirty days. Press 5 to add one.
strings.dash.NoAccountsYetPress2: No accounts yet. Press 2 for Accounts, then a to add one.
strings.tx.OnlyThisCategoryEscShows: Only this category; Esc shows everything again
strings.manage.NoRatesYetAnAccount: No rates yet. An account in another currency needs one to be counted in liquid funds and net worth; without it every entry has to carry its own.
strings.manage.NoPayeesYetNameOne: No payees yet. Name one on a transaction and it appears here, where it can be renamed, given the spellings a statement uses, or folded into another.
strings.manage.AlarmsGoToTheDesktop: Alarms go to the desktop. Evaluation is switched on in Settings.
strings.manage.NothingArmedPressATo: Nothing armed. Press a to watch a budget line going over, a bill slipping past its date, a large posting, or an account running low.
strings.alertform.OneOfTheTwoA: One of the two: a watch fires on the sample that carries the figure past the bound.
strings.alertform.OffItRingsOnceAnd: Off: it rings once and disarms itself
strings.alertform.NothingStaysArmedForEver: Nothing stays armed for ever; a watch expires when its span runs out.
strings.bills.NothingDueInTheNext: Nothing due in the next sixty days. Press a to add a bill.
strings.quickadd.AmountAndCategoryAreEnough: Amount and category are enough. Tab from the amount to find a category: Enter picks it, Enter again saves. Escape closes a picker, then the card.
strings.reports.NothingSpentInThisWindow: Nothing spent in this window or the one before.
strings.reports.JKMoveEnterOpen: j k move   Enter open   t transactions   [ ] period
strings.billform.Name: NAME
strings.catform.Name: NAME
strings.catform.TheIdAndEveryTransaction: The id and every transaction behind it stay as they are.
strings.catform.GroupsCarryTheGlyphA: Groups carry the glyph; a child without one borrows it.
strings.catform.UnderTheEnvelopeModelMonthly: Under the envelope model: monthly starts again each period, rollover keeps what is left or short, untracked is never budgeted.
strings.catform.AGoalKeepsWhatIs: A goal keeps what is left each period, and the Budget screen suggests what to put in to reach the target in time.
strings.catform.OutOfThePickersHistory: Out of the pickers, history kept
strings.catform.AGroupHandsBothOf: A group hands both of those down to the categories under it.
strings.catform.OnlyACategoryNothingPoints: Only a category nothing points at can go; anything with history is archived instead
strings.reconcile.PutInWhatTheStatement: Put in what the statement closed at. Tick the lines it shows, leave the rest pending, and settle it when the difference is nothing.
strings.reconcile.EveryTickedLineBecomesReconcil: Every ticked line becomes reconciled and closes for good
strings.reconcile.JKMoveSpaceTick: j k move   Space tick   A transfer is one line with one status, so settling it here settles it on both accounts.
strings.budget.AnyCategoryIncludingTheOnes: Any category, including the ones with nothing on them yet
strings.budget.CopyThePreviousPeriodS: Copy the previous period's lines here
strings.budget.PlanEveryLineFromThe: Plan every line from the average of the last three periods
strings.budget.PlanEveryLineFromThe2: Plan every line from the median of the last twelve periods
strings.budget.CarryThePreviousPeriodS: Carry the previous period's pots into this one
strings.budget.ACategoryWithNothingOn: A category with nothing on it yet never appears in the table, so this is where it joins the plan.
strings.budget.ThePotKeepsWhatIs: The pot keeps what is left each period and the app suggests what to put in to reach the target in time.
strings.privacy.EverythingLivesInOneSqlite: Everything lives in one SQLite file on this machine. No cloud, no tracking, no bank connection. The daemon listens on the loopback address and opens one connection outward only when you press Fetch now in Settings or run omabudget rate fetch: to the exchange rate source chosen there, and never on its own.
strings.privacy.TheLedgerAccountsTransactionsBud: The ledger: accounts, transactions, budgets, rules. Kept at mode 0600.
strings.privacy.SettingsAndTheApiToken: Settings and the API token. Never synced anywhere by the app.
strings.privacy.AlertTriggersIfYouArmed: Alert triggers, if you armed any.
strings.privacy.KeepTheFolderOutOf: Keep the folder out of file sync: a database synced while open ends up corrupt. Take a backup or an export instead.
strings.privacy.OneConnectionOnlyWhenYou: One connection, only when you press Fetch now in Settings or run omabudget rate fetch, to the exchange rate source chosen there. The whole list of rates is read, so the request says nothing about what you hold. Nothing else leaves this machine.
strings.privacy.ADeletedTransactionStaysIn: A deleted transaction stays in the recycle bin for thirty days, restorable from the Transactions view with u or b, then it is gone for good.
strings.privacy.InATerminalInThis: In a terminal, in this order: the data first, because the second command deletes the program that knows how to do it.
strings.privacy.APlainTextJournalThat: A plain-text journal that accounting tools read, every entry balanced, or the transactions as CSV.
strings.privacy.AConsistentCopyOfThe: A consistent copy of the database, taken while the daemon runs. Restore by stopping the daemon and putting the copy in place of ledger.db.
strings.privacy.PathsStayInsideYourHome: Paths stay inside your home directory; the daemon refuses anything else.
strings.privacy.OnlyWhenTheAgentEndpoint: Only when the agent endpoint is on, in Settings, and only with the token: the dashboard, transactions, the budget, bills and the spending report, one tool to record a transaction, and the alert watches. Nothing reaches an agent on its own, and nothing leaves this machine.
strings.txform.WhatLandedInTheOther: what landed in the other account
strings.txform.BookOneAmountAcrossSeveral: Book one amount across several categories
strings.txform.PutTheRestOnThe: Put the rest on the last line
strings.settings.EveryFigureIsConvertedInto: Every figure is converted into it at today's rate on file, so it needs a rate unless it is
strings.settings.LimitsAPlannedAmountPer: Limits: a planned amount per category, overspending is shown. Envelopes: money is assigned to pots first, what is left rolls over by each category's behaviour.
strings.settings.1To28PickYour: 1 to 28. Pick your payday and every period, statistic and budget follows it.
strings.settings.EmptyReadsThePublicInstance: Empty reads the public instance. An instance you run yourself is read over https, or plain http only on this machine or a private address.
strings.settings.OneRequestToTheSource: One request to the source above, every currency it publishes
strings.settings.NothingIsFetchedUnlessYou: Nothing is fetched unless you press this or run omabudget rate fetch. The whole list is read, so the request says nothing about what you hold; a rate you typed is never overwritten. Bitcoin, Decred, Litecoin and Ether are on neither source and stay hand entered under Manage.
strings.settings.NothingToFileNoCurrency: Nothing to file: no currency in use is quoted by this source.
strings.settings.BudgetLinesAtWarnOr: Budget lines at warn or over, bills due or overdue, large postings, low accounts
strings.settings.PostingsAtOrAboveThis: Postings at or above this amount appear in the large-postings list that triggers can watch. Empty turns it off.
strings.settings.ToolsOn12700: Tools on 127.0.0.1 only, behind the token below
strings.settings.EveryClientHoldingTheOld: Every client holding the old token is locked out
strings.settings.HHidesTheTokenWith: h hides the token with the amounts
strings.settings.ListensOnTheLoopbackAddress: Listens on the loopback address only. Every read and write, this window included, goes through the CLI and the token.
strings.settings.HyprlandTilesThisWindowUnless: Hyprland tiles this window unless told otherwise. Add to ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua:
strings.source.ecb.name: European Central Bank
strings.source.ecb.what: The official daily reference rates, read from the bank itself. No third party sees the request.
strings.source.frankfurter.name: Frankfurter
strings.source.frankfurter.what: The same reference rates as JSON, from the public instance or one you run yourself.
strings.settings.ChoosingASourceIsChoosing: Choosing a source is choosing who sees your address when you press Fetch now.
